integrity: The if-and-only-if ranges are proved algebraically from the rational stability function and nilpotent-shift functional calculus. Exact-rational replay checks the stated witness, row sums, and the isolating bracket for the unique positive root. Literature comparisons were statement-level; a residual terminology risk remains for older SSP/extrapolation literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to homogeneous unit-rate absorbing pure-birth chains with N=2,3,4,5 and the second-order Richardson combination of backward Euler. It makes no minimal-dimension claim for arbitrary CTMC generators or nonuniform birth rates and does not classify higher extrapolation levels.
title: Re-entrant positivity of Richardson-extrapolated backward Euler on five-state pure-birth chains
